segments.text:
If ever you will succeed and prosp•… in the work of mortification, then get and daily exercise more faith. Faith is the great instrument of mortification. This is the victory (or sword by which the victory is won, the instrument) by which you overcome the world, even your faith, 1 John 5. 4. By faith alone eternal things are discovered to our souls in their reality and excelling glory, and these are the preponderating things for the sake whereof self-denial and mortification becomes easie to believers; by opposing things eternal to things temporal we resist
Satan, 1 Pet. 5. 8. This is the shield by which we quench the fiery darts of the wicked one, Eph. 6. 16.
